card.architecture: Anime line-art extractor (comfyui_controlnet_aux AnimeLineArtPreprocessor) + invert + thicken + multiply composite — no diffusion checkpoint
card.summary: Extracts the anime line art with a neural detector, inverts to dark-on-white, boldens the lines, and multiplies them back over the source so only the outlines darken. The detector fetches its own weights from HuggingFace on first run.
use_cases: thicken outlines using a learned anime line extractor
card.pick_when: A learned anime line extractor isolates outlines better than XDoG on busy art.
